nodes.Name: J0
nodes.DocComment:
J0 returns the order-zero Bessel function of the first kind.

Special cases are:

	J0(±Inf) = 0
	J0(0) = 1
	J0(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Y0
nodes.DocComment:
Y0 returns the order-zero Bessel function of the second kind.

Special cases are:

	Y0(+Inf) = 0
	Y0(0) = -Inf
	Y0(x < 0) = NaN
	Y0(NaN) = NaN
